'use client';
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Zap, TableProperties, Video } from 'lucide-react';
import { PipelineView } from './PipelineView';
import { BillQueueView } from './BillQueueView';
import { WalkthroughView } from './WalkthroughView';
import styles from './HeroProductPanel.module.css';

interface HeroProductPanelProps {
  onTabChange?: (tabIndex: number) => void;
}

const tabs = [
  { label: 'Live Pipeline', icon: Zap },
  { label: 'Finance Bill Queue', icon: TableProperties },
  { label: '2-Min Walkthrough', icon: Video },
];

export const HeroProductPanel: React.FC<HeroProductPanelProps> = ({ onTabChange }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(0);
  const [isPermanentlyStopped, setIsPermanentlyStopped] = useState(false);
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true);
  const [reducedMotion, setReducedMotion] = useState(false);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tabListRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previousTab = useRef(0);
  const canAutoCycle = !isPermanentlyStopped && !isHovered && isVisible && !reducedMotion;

  const stopAutoCycle = () => setIsPermanentlyStopped(true);

  const handleTabClick = (index: number) => {
    setActiveTab(index);
    stopAutoCycle();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
    const nextIndex = event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? (index + 1) % tabs.length
      : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? (index + tabs.length - 1) % tabs.length
      : event.key === 'Home' ? 0
      : event.key === 'End' ? tabs.length - 1 : null;
    if (nextIndex === null) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    handleTabClick(nextIndex);
    tabListRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="tab"]')[nextIndex]?.focus();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const preference = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const updatePreference = () => setReducedMotion(preference.matches);
    updatePreference();
    preference.addEventListener('change', updatePreference);
    return () => preference.removeEventListener('change', updatePreference);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canAutoCycle) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (!document.hidden) setActiveTab((current) => (current + 1) % tabs.length);
    }, 8000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [canAutoCycle]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (previousTab.current !== activeTab) {
      previousTab.current = activeTab;
      onTabChange?.(activeTab);
    }
  }, [activeTab, onTabChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (!panel) return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => setIsVisible(entry.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.1 });
    observer.observe(panel);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={panelRef}
      onMouseEnter={() => { setIsHovered(true); stopAutoCycle(); }}
      onMouseLeave={() => setIsHovered(false)}
      onFocus={stopAutoCycle}
      onClick={stopAutoCycle}
      onTouchStart={stopAutoCycle}
      className={`${styles.stack} relative w-full min-w-0`}
    >
      <div className={styles.backLayer} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className={styles.middleLayer} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className={`${styles.console} relative min-h-[520px] rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-5`}>
        <div className={styles.titlebar}>
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            <span className={styles.brandMark} aria-hidden="true">D</span>
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-100">Docsynecx</span>
            <span className="text-slate-500">/</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-300">Finance desk</span>
          </div>
          <span className={`${styles.connected} text-[10.5px] font-bold`}>
            <span className={styles.statusDot} />
            Tally Prime connected
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.navigation}>
          <div ref={tabListRef} role="tablist" aria-label="Docsynecx hero panel views" className={styles.tabs}>
            {tabs.map(({ label, icon: Icon }, index) => (
              <button
                key={label}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                id={`hero-tab-${index}`}
                aria-selected={activeTab === index}
                aria-controls={`hero-panel-${index}`}
                tabIndex={activeTab === index ? 0 : -1}
                onClick={() => handleTabClick(index)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => handleKeyDown(event, index)}
                className={`${styles.tab} font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-tight`}
              >
                <Icon size={13} aria-hidden="true" className={styles.tabIcon} />
                <span>{label}</span>
                {index === 0 && <span className={styles.statusDot} />}
                {index === 1 && <span className={`${styles.queueCount} text-[9.5px]`}>24</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <span className={`${styles.telemetry} font-mono text-[10px]`}>
            <span className={styles.statusDot} />
            Auto-sync telemetry
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.progressTrack} aria-hidden="true">
          <div key={activeTab} className={styles.progress} data-running={canAutoCycle} data-stopped={isPermanentlyStopped || reducedMotion} />
        </div>

        {/* Overlapping grid cells reserve the tallest view before hydration and on every tab. */}
        <div className={`${styles.viewport} min-h-[490px]`}>
          <div id="hero-panel-0" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="hero-tab-0" aria-hidden={activeTab !== 0}
            tabIndex={activeTab === 0 ? 0 : -1} data-active={activeTab === 0} className={styles.view}>
            <PipelineView isPaused={activeTab !== 0 || isHovered || !isVisible || reducedMotion} />
          </div>
          <div id="hero-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="hero-tab-1" aria-hidden={activeTab !== 1}
            tabIndex={activeTab === 1 ? 0 : -1} data-active={activeTab === 1} className={`${styles.view} ${styles.queueView}`}>
            <BillQueueView />
          </div>
          <div id="hero-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="hero-tab-2" aria-hidden={activeTab !== 2}
            tabIndex={activeTab === 2 ? 0 : -1} data-active={activeTab === 2} className={`${styles.view} ${styles.walkthroughView}`}>
            <WalkthroughView isPaused={activeTab !== 2 || !isVisible || reducedMotion} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={`${styles.footer} font-mono text-[10.5px]`}>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-slate-200">
            <span className={styles.statusDot} />
            Direct ERP &amp; Tally Prime Sync
          </span>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-400">
            <span>Avg. speed: <b className="font-bold text-slate-200">4.2s</b></span>
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-slate-600">|</span>
            <span>Accuracy: <b className="font-bold text-emerald-300">99.8%</b></span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 text-right font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">Illustrative demo data</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
